evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains creation, invitation, joining, and deletion of games so the create-game capability is supported and complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invite via URL is supported by game creation (PP-001) and join story (PP-029); complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes adding, editing, deleting, selecting, and listing items (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008, PP-004), so round item lifecycle is covered.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Item listing complements item creation/edit/delete and selection stories, so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items relies on existing item CRUD and listing stories which are present (PP-006, PP-004), so capability is complete.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items
evaluations.rationale: Add is present and complemented by edit/delete/list/select stories (PP-007, PP-008, PP-004, PP-005).

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Edit is supported together with create/add (PP-006), delete (PP-008), and list (PP-004), so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items
evaluations.rationale: Delete complements add/edit/list/select stories; creation and listing are present (PP-006, PP-004).

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates early is supported by estimate-giving and display stories (PP-033, PP-036); no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average is supported by storing estimates and transcript/export features; no missing complementary capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill behavior relies on showing cards and collecting estimates (PP-033, PP-036), which exist; complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering an agreed estimate is supported by moderator workflows including viewing and accepting estimates; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating earlier session items is supported by listing and history navigation stories (PP-004, PP-039); complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import and copy/paste capabilities exist (PP-015) alongside item lifecycle stories, so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste complements import and item management stories; necessary capabilities for adding/editing/removing items exist.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by transcript/export and delete features (PP-017-019, PP-020); storage and retrieval capabilities are implied by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcript viewing is complemented by export and browsing stories (PP-018, PP-019, PP-016); necessary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript ... as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export functionality complements transcript viewing and storage; complementary capabilities exist (PP-017, PP-019).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript ... as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript viewing and data storage; complementary capabilities present (PP-017, PP-018).

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete-game complements create-game (PP-001) and browsing/exporting of games; necessary complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation, login, change and deletion stories are present (PP-022, PP-023, PP-024), so account lifecycle is complete except for optional profile fields.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is supported together with account creation and password reminders (PP-021, PP-026); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account editing complements creation and deletion stories (PP-021, PP-024); no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion complements creation and login; related account-management stories exist (PP-021, PP-022).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is self-contained and does not require other missing capabilities to be feature-complete.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder complements account creation/login (PP-021, PP-022); necessary complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, ...} or {0, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Card-set selection is self-contained and does not expose a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation limits complement invite/join stories (PP-002, PP-029); no required complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining by name is supported by invitation and account stories; complementary capabilities for identification are present (PP-002, PP-021).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is supported by item selection and listing stories (PP-005, PP-004); complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Item overview is supported by add/edit/delete/list stories; no missing complementary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Estimate presence and identity are supported by estimate display and join/identify stories (PP-033, PP-029); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Synchronous reveal is covered and complements estimate collection and display stories; no required complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Changing estimates before reveal is supported by the estimate lifecycle and reveal stories; complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is supported by prior-round history/navigation (PP-039) and transcript features (PP-017); complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Displaying per-estimator estimates is supported by join and estimate-display stories (PP-029, PP-033); no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer functionality is self-contained; no complementary capability is missing from the backlog for this feature.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Reset behavior ties to estimate collection and reveal stories which are present (PP-033, PP-034); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: History navigation is supported alongside transcript/exporting and re-estimation stories (PP-017, PP-013); no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a UI requirement that does not depend on a missing complementary capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This behavior is covered by estimate collection and reveal stories (PP-033, PP-034); complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail implies a way to supply or set that photo (upload, link, or select an avatar), but there is no story describing how a user/estimator provides their photo or avatar (no upload/set-avatar story).

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility and standards compliance is a cross-cutting nonfunctional goal; no missing complementary capability that prevents the feature set from being complete.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions is self-contained; no complementary capabilities are required elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related developer tasks are complementary to functional stories and do not indicate missing functional capabilities in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser support is a quality goal; it does not expose a missing complementary functional requirement in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a non-functional objective and doesn't indicate a missing functional story.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement is non-functional and doesn't reveal a missing functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a non-functional/technical requirement and complementary capabilities are not missing from the functional set.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a UI/architectural concern and does not indicate a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error-page design is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization is a cross-cutting requirement; while it may interact with avatars (PP-042), the backlog provides account and anonymization intent—no additional missing functional capability for storing results is evident.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics collection is supported by transcript/export and storage-related stories; no missing complementary capability is apparent in the backlog.
